             break;
         case END_OBJECT:
             writeEndObject();
             break;
         case START_ARRAY:

             break;
         case END_ARRAY:

         case FIELD_NAME:

                 writeString(p.getText());
             }
             break;
         case VALUE_NUMBER_INT:
             switch (p.getNumberType()) {
             case INT:
                 writeNumber(p.getIntValue());
                 break;
             case BIG_INTEGER:
                 writeNumber(p.getBigIntegerValue());

                     break;

             break;

             t = jp.nextToken();
             // fall-through to copy the associated value
         }
 
         if (_mayHaveNativeIds) {
             _checkNativeIds(jp);
         }
         
         switch (t) {
         case START_ARRAY:
             writeStartArray();
             while (jp.nextToken() != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
                 copyCurrentStructure(jp);
             }
             writeEndArray();
             break;
         case START_OBJECT:
             writeStartObject();

             writeEndObject();
             break;
         default: // others are simple:
             copyCurrentEvent(jp);

             _hasNativeId = true;
